FILES: arrow/arrow.py:842-864
ROOT CAUSE: The `Arrow.format` method currently only supports a single default format string and requires the user to provide a string for common formats.
CHANGE: Introduce predefined constant format strings (e.g., `ARROW_FORMAT_ISO8601`, `ARROW_FORMAT_TIMESTAMP`, etc.) or a mapping of common format aliases to their corresponding format strings in `Arrow.format` or a new utility, allowing users to use these built-in formats. Based on the issue "Create built-in format strings for common formats", I will modify `Arrow.format` to support named presets or add these as constants.
TEST: tests/test_arrow.py
